claim: The Profile Concept §: a parameter's numeric range hides its perceptual geometry; named regions ('closed / dark / open / bright') are what keep generated presets from wearing 'the same blank face'.

pieces.what: one-knob ladders on Vital's init patch (cutoff, resonance, attack) with the proposed region bands drawn over the rendered measurements; tests whether the named regions sit where the ear hears the change
pieces.walks_up_from: one knob, cutoff, swept on a plain init patch

pieces.what: a library preset's render beside its Track B plain-language description; tests whether the description lets you hear what it says
pieces.walks_up_from: one preset, read parameter by parameter
